canonical_surface.description: The single application-level process entry capable of evaluating all 1,555 household scores. It parses the CLI, loads the canonical Phase-5 YAML itself, binds its digest, authenticates every gate, and only then creates the opaque process-local authorization context that the nested score provider requires.

post_evaluation_reauthentication.note: every full-score process reauthenticates before publication
